items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: His son was playing drums with him. He's a good drummer

ctx.x: Not that kind of publicity, huh?

His son was playing drums with him. He's a good drummer, and they had a bass player over there. I don't know his name, but he's a member of our union. But he is one hell of a good bass player. I mean electric bass. He's got a beautiful ear. I made a record with him. I made a record with him. And this boy, he reminded me that he was Leon's piano player, a bass player. But he is one hell of a classy, faking bass player that plays another netto. But he plays electric. Doesn't play upright, huh?
